# RefactorKit 0.7.0

Bounded Java, TypeScript/JavaScript and Kotlin refactoring with preview, diagnostics,
explicit approval and managed rollback. API remains **0.2**.

- Java: completed finite J1 catalogue, corrected navigation and exact packaged
  Maven module-rename authority.
- TypeScript/JavaScript: compiler-owned advanced operations, source/configuration
  boundaries, generation-bound approvals and retained-child recipes. Unsupported
  change-signature/inline-function requests remain explicit refusals.
- Kotlin: bounded completion/move-next gates reuse the existing compiler and
  semantic infrastructure; no claim of universal Kotlin refactoring support.
- Recovery: staging cleanup requires retained successful-creation identity and
  exact images; legacy, missing or conflicting ownership proof fails closed.

## Qualification and limits

Only **Linux x86-64** is shipped for this release. Repeated other-host qualification
is **WAIVED_BY_USER / not verified**, not PASS. The waiver is specific to0.7.0;
Windows/macOS users retain the separately qualified0.6.2 assets.

Published acceptance requires the source/version, native scenarios, runtime,
checksums, SPDX, build/SBOM attestations and independently downloaded bytes to join.
The `.release.json` asset records build-time qualification; its pending independent
review fields describe that earlier phase, not an invented build-time review.
The final acceptance record and release notes report the later downloaded-asset join.

Static findings remain configured nonblocking; numerical coverage is unmeasured.
Live uncooperative replacement races, unqualified filesystem identity and power-loss
behavior are not covered by the bounded recovery evidence. LSP edits remain
client-managed where specified, not RefactorKit-managed WAL/rollback.

Architecture/status authority: [ARC42](https://github.com/mgiustiniani/refactorkit/blob/v0.7.0/docs/arc42/appendix-requirements.adoc).
Scope and history: [local acceptance](https://github.com/mgiustiniani/refactorkit/blob/v0.7.0/docs/releases/v0.7.0-final-local-acceptance.md)
and [host exception](https://github.com/mgiustiniani/refactorkit/blob/v0.7.0/docs/requirements/v0.7.0-local-host-acceptance-approved-change-001.md).
